sampling.input: StarRhythmAdjustButton.OnPress(true); no click debounce; release is ignored
sampling.consume: Update advances rhythmAdjustTimer, consumes one touched flag, then clears it
sampling.perWindow: first accepted tap only; trunc((target - barProgress) / progressPerFrame)
sampling.aggregate: mean of valid integer samples, round nearest ties to even; no samples returns zero
sampling.finish: 6.5 seconds then a one-second reverberation wait, sound-stack resume with 0.25-second fade, invokes confirm and opens done automatically
sampling.confirmEntry: ButtonOK is inactive in the authored prefab; finish invokes the confirmation callback automatically

result.accept: replace JudgementAdjustValue, do not add the old value; judgement B unchanged
result.retake: onClickRetake jumps to onPressOK and opens sampling directly, not ready

audio.readyCancel: stop short and restore stacked BGM/voice

boundaries: Host audio and input clocks are used. Android latency state names do not justify emulating Android/CRI internals. Evidence is static original code and authored resources, not a visual or physical-latency equivalence claim.

particles.cameraViewport: full screen; no render texture; retain authored orthographic size and clip planes
particles.scaling: Local (1): parent scale changes emitter placement, not particle size; window tween is not a scale of the rendered camera image
particles.blend: SrcAlpha One; DOM integration must retain addition to the existing backdrop
particles.restart: Clear, Stop, Play; selected particle root and authored descendants
particles.activation: Play with children preserves GameObject active-in-hierarchy: Sring_1, light_lay_2, kira (1), kira remain inactive. The root renderer is disabled, independently of root simulation.
particles.moduleActivation: Serialized disabled modules retain parameters but must not be registered as executable modules. GameObject activity and module enable flags are separate gates.

cameraOrder.registrationKey: floor(depth * 1000); increment an occupied key; ApplyStack enumerates the SortedList in order

particles.windowClip: The calibration prefab has no UIPanel/SpriteMask clipping region; its additive shader uses camera MVP and texture-times-vertex-color, without a title/button/TapArea rectangle clip. Geometry reaching another widget is not alone proof of an algorithm difference.

tiles.tileSize: inner UV extent times texture dimensions times atlas pixelSize
tiles.end: clip last tile geometry and UVs; do not stretch one tile across the widget
tiles.drawingDimensions: UISprite.get_drawingDimensions skips whole-widget atlas padding for type 2 at 0x3088540-0x3088548; drawRegion still applies.
tiles.padding: UISprite.get_padding returns left,bottom,right,top source pixels. TiledFill applies leading padding before each tile and trailing padding after it; both scale by atlas pixelSize.
tiles.stride: inner tile extent + leading padding + trailing padding; hierarchy scale and rotation apply after local mesh construction.
